profiles.name: Sample Estates
profiles.tagline: Homes for sale and to rent in Harare's northern suburbs.
profiles.about: Sample Estates sells and lets houses, townhouses and apartments in Harare. The team handles viewings, offers and lease paperwork, and keeps every enquiry on record from first message to handover.

profiles.name: Sample Realty
profiles.tagline: Family homes and apartments in Harare and Mutare.
profiles.about: Sample Realty markets family homes, apartments and townhouses. It works with first-time buyers as well as owners moving up, and has an office in Mutare.

profiles.name: Sample Commercial
profiles.tagline: Offices, retail and industrial space to let and for sale.
profiles.about: Sample Commercial lets and sells offices, shops and warehouses in Harare. It advises tenants on space planning and landlords on lease terms.

profiles.name: Sample Land Agents
profiles.tagline: Serviced stands, plots and farms with clean title.
profiles.about: Sample Land Agents specialises in residential stands, plots and agricultural land. Every listing is checked for title, servicing and access before it is advertised.

profiles.name: Sample Homes Bulawayo
profiles.tagline: Houses for sale and to rent across Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sample Homes Bulawayo is a local agency covering the city's established suburbs. It manages sales and rentals and knows the schools, roads and water situation street by street.

profiles.name: Rudo Moyo
profiles.tagline: Leads the sales team at Sample Estates.
profiles.about: Rudo runs Sample Estates and oversees every sale and lease the agency handles. She has worked in Harare residential property for more than fifteen years.

profiles.name: Tendai Ncube
profiles.tagline: Houses and apartments in Borrowdale, Avondale and Mount Pleasant.
profiles.about: Tendai handles both sales and rentals and is usually the person showing you around. He answers enquiries the same day.

profiles.name: Chipo Dube
profiles.tagline: Family homes, apartments and cottages in Harare.
profiles.about: Chipo works with families looking for their next home and with tenants looking for cottages and apartments close to work.

profiles.name: Tatenda Mutasa
profiles.tagline: Homes in Harare's eastern suburbs and in Mutare.
profiles.about: Tatenda founded Sample Realty and still handles listings personally, from contemporary homes in Glen Lorne to family houses in Mutare.

profiles.name: Farai Chikwanha
profiles.tagline: Office space in and around the Harare CBD.
profiles.about: Farai matches businesses with office space and negotiates lease terms for both tenants and landlords.

profiles.name: Nomsa Sibanda
profiles.tagline: Stands and plots in Bulawayo, Ruwa and Mutare.
profiles.about: Nomsa sells residential stands and plots and walks buyers through title, servicing and payment terms before they commit.

profiles.name: Sipho Nkomo
profiles.tagline: Family houses for sale and to rent in Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sipho has lived in Bulawayo all his life and sells and lets houses in its older suburbs.

profiles.name: Sample Developments
profiles.tagline: Serviced stands and cluster homes in secure estates.
profiles.about: Sample Developments plans and builds gated residential estates around Harare, selling serviced stands and completed cluster homes with staged payment terms.

profiles.name: Sample Urban Builders
profiles.tagline: Mid-rise apartments and townhouse complexes in Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sample Urban Builders develops sectional-title apartments and small townhouse complexes close to schools and transport.

profiles.name: Sample Heights
profiles.tagline: Homes and lodges near the Victoria Falls.
profiles.about: Sample Heights builds low-density homes and small hospitality projects in Victoria Falls, designed for the climate and the setting.

profiles.name: Sample Property Management
profiles.tagline: Rent collection, maintenance and inspections for owners.
profiles.about: Sample Property Management looks after houses, apartment blocks and offices on behalf of their owners: finding tenants, collecting rent, arranging repairs and reporting every month.

profiles.name: Sample Rentals Bulawayo
profiles.tagline: A landlord with houses and flats to let in Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sample Rentals Bulawayo owns and lets a portfolio of houses and flats, and manages them directly.

profiles.name: Sample Falls Stays
profiles.tagline: Self-catering houses and cottages near the Victoria Falls.
profiles.about: Sample Falls Stays hosts visitors in self-catering houses and garden cottages a short drive from the Falls, for a few nights or a few weeks.

profiles.name: Sample Showrooms
profiles.tagline: Showrooms and event space to hire by the hour in Harare.
profiles.about: Sample Showrooms lets furnished showroom and event space by the hour for launches, exhibitions and pop-up retail.

profiles.name: Sample Plumbers
profiles.tagline: Emergency call-outs, geysers and full bathroom plumbing.
profiles.about: Sample Plumbers is a team of qualified plumbers working on homes, rental properties and offices across Harare. They quote before they start and leave the site clean.

offerings.name: Burst pipes and leaks
offerings.description: Same-day call-outs to find and fix leaks, burst pipes and blocked drains.

offerings.name: Geysers
offerings.description: Supply, installation and repair of electric and solar geysers.

offerings.name: Bathrooms and kitchens
offerings.description: First and second fix plumbing for renovations and new builds.

offerings.name: Water tanks and pumps
offerings.description: Installing tanks, booster pumps and pressure systems for borehole or municipal water.

profiles.name: Sample Rapid Plumbing
profiles.tagline: Blocked drains, leaks and maintenance contracts for landlords.
profiles.about: Sample Rapid Plumbing looks after houses and blocks of flats in Bulawayo, with maintenance contracts for landlords and agents who need a plumber they can rely on.

offerings.name: Blocked drains
offerings.description: Rodding and jetting for sinks, toilets and sewer lines.

offerings.name: Leak detection
offerings.description: Finding hidden leaks behind walls and under floors before they cause damage.

offerings.name: Landlord maintenance
offerings.description: A fixed monthly arrangement for repairs across a rental portfolio.

profiles.name: Sample Electricians
profiles.tagline: Licensed electricians for homes, shops and offices.
profiles.about: Sample Electricians carries out wiring, fault finding and compliance work. Every job is signed off by a licensed electrician.

offerings.name: Fault finding and repairs
offerings.description: Tripping breakers, dead circuits and burnt sockets traced and repaired.

offerings.name: Rewiring and new installations
offerings.description: Wiring for renovations, extensions and new buildings.

offerings.name: Certificates of compliance
offerings.description: Inspection and certification for sales, lettings and insurance.

offerings.name: Backup power changeovers
offerings.description: Generator and inverter changeover switches fitted safely.

profiles.name: Sample Sparks
profiles.tagline: Domestic and commercial electrical work in Bulawayo.
profiles.about: Sample Sparks is a small firm of electricians handling everything from a new plug point to a full distribution board upgrade.

offerings.name: Distribution boards
offerings.description: Upgrades, earth leakage protection and surge protection.

offerings.name: Lighting
offerings.description: Indoor, security and garden lighting, including LED conversions.

offerings.name: Electric fences and gates
offerings.description: Installation and repair of electric fencing and gate motors.

profiles.name: Sample Solar Installers
profiles.tagline: Solar systems sized for your home, with batteries and backup.
profiles.about: Sample Solar Installers designs and fits solar power systems for homes and small businesses. They start with a load assessment, so the system matches what you actually use.

offerings.name: Home solar systems
offerings.description: Panels, inverter and lithium batteries sized from a load assessment.

offerings.name: Solar geysers
offerings.description: Replacing electric geysers with solar water heating.

offerings.name: Business and farm systems
offerings.description: Larger systems for offices, shops, boreholes and irrigation.

offerings.name: Servicing and upgrades
offerings.description: Health checks, panel cleaning and adding batteries or panels to an existing system.

profiles.name: Sample Sun Power
profiles.tagline: Affordable solar kits and installations in Matabeleland.
profiles.about: Sample Sun Power supplies and installs solar kits for lights, fridges and televisions, through to full off-grid systems for homes outside town.

offerings.name: Starter solar kits
offerings.description: Entry-level kits that keep lights, phones and a television running.

offerings.name: Off-grid systems
offerings.description: Complete systems for homes and lodges with no mains connection.

offerings.name: Solar borehole pumps
offerings.description: Solar-powered pumping for boreholes and tanks.

profiles.name: Sample Borehole Drillers
profiles.tagline: Siting, drilling and equipping boreholes.
profiles.about: Sample Borehole Drillers surveys, drills and equips boreholes for homes, estates and farms, and services existing pumps.

offerings.name: Siting and drilling
offerings.description: Geophysical survey followed by drilling and casing.

offerings.name: Pumps and tanks
offerings.description: Submersible pumps, tank stands and storage tanks installed.

offerings.name: Servicing
offerings.description: Pump repairs, flushing and yield testing for existing boreholes.

offerings.name: Property transfers

offerings.name: Agreements and leases
